audit.why: Six fields claim Blinding Dart cancels Purge (spikes[0].text, wants.you[0], early, whys[0], whys[2], late). I went to the Wiki to check this because the kit file cannot answer it and Echoing Flames' own text lists "basic attacks and Purge" as two separate triggers, which reads as though Purge is not a basic attack. The Wiki settles it the other way: "The bolts are considered basic attacks and thus apply life steal at full efficiency." Blind therefore does blank Purge, and the entry's central claim stands. I strengthened the wording to say why rather than changing the advice.
audit.corrected: Purge bolts are basic attacks, so the blind blanks the channel — the entry was right.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] is labelled "Lvl 4-5" but reads "Noxious Trap seals the tribush"; mid tells you to "plant Noxious Trap (R) on the tribush and both river brushes" in its levels 4-5 paragraph and then says "At level 6 your traps begin covering both side entrances".
audit.why: Noxious Trap is the ultimate, so there are no mushrooms before level 6 — and mid contradicts itself two sentences apart, telling the player to plant traps at 4-5 and then dating the traps to 6. The levels 4-5 window is decided purely by spacing.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 are spacing only; mushrooms start at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: No range numbers anywhere, and early advises "Play slightly back of your usual poke range so Q slow alone cannot put you in his E cast radius".
audit.why: That advice cannot work: Corrosive Charge is 800 range against Teemo's 680, so Urgot outranges Teemo's poke and there is no standing position that avoids his Q. It is a ground-targeted circle you sidestep, not something you outrange. The numbers that do matter are Purge 490 and Disdain 475 against your 680 — you comfortably outrange both of those, which is the actual reason the lane works.
audit.corrected: Corrosive Charge 800 outranges your 680 — sidestep it. Purge 490 and Disdain 475 are both well inside your range.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] ("2+ items") explains Urgot's scaling purely as "percent-max-HP damage from Purge" and tankiness.
audit.why: Purge is 12/9/6/3/0 seconds — at max rank it has no cooldown at all. That, not a damage-per-tick curve, is what changes about the matchup late: the window between Purge activations that Teemo relies on for the kite loop stops existing.
audit.corrected: Purge reaches 0 cooldown at max rank — permanently available.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Blinding Shot" in spikes[0].text, early, whys[0]; "Liandry's Angueur" in whys[5].
audit.why: Teemo's Q is Blinding Dart. "Liandry's Angueur" is not a real item; the full layer writes Liandry's Torment.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Disdain as the matchup-defining cooldown in several places but never gives its timer.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and it also shields him on the charge, which the entry never mentions. A missed Disdain at rank 1 is a 16-second window where Urgot has no way to reach a Teemo holding 680.
audit.corrected: Disdain 16s at rank 1, and it shields him while charging.

edits.before: Blinding Shot already shuts down Urgot's auto-attack trades and Purge legs need him in range — poke freely and deny his ability to proc Purge at all.
edits.after: Blinding Dart shuts down Urgot's autos and his Purge alike — the bolts count as basic attacks, so the blind blanks them, and Purge only reaches 490 into your 680.

edits.before: Q is near max rank and Noxious Trap seals the tribush — Urgot cannot step into river brush or zone your wave without walking into shrooms and your poison kite loop.
edits.after: No mushrooms until 6, so this window is pure spacing: Purge reaches 490 and Disdain 475 against your 680 — hold that gap and punish each walk-up instead of chasing a kill.

edits.before: Urgot's percent-max-HP damage from Purge (W) starts to outpace your poison DoT total — his tankiness lets him sustain through Liandry's ticks long enough to flip and execute.
edits.after: Purge falls to a 0-second cooldown at max rank, so the gaps your kite loop depends on stop existing — and his tankiness now absorbs Liandry's ticks long enough to flip and execute you.

edits.before: Blind (Q) every time Urgot tries to Purge-walk into you, cancelling his shotgun-leg damage windows entirely
edits.after: Blind every time Urgot Purge-walks into you — the bolts are basic attacks, so the blind blanks them all

edits.before: Keep 550+ range between you and his E (Disdain) at all times — poison kite with W speed and shroom cover on the tribush entrance
edits.after: Disdain reaches 475 and Purge 490 — hold your own 680 auto range and poison kite with W speed rather than trusting shroom cover

edits.before: Urgot cannot trade at level 1 without walking into your auto range, so the second he steps up to CS, land Blinding Shot (Q) and let E Toxic Shot coat his approach. He has no dash to close gap and his Purge (W) only fires while he walks toward you — Q blind cancels every auto and leg-shot in that window, so he loses the exchange entirely. Respect one thing: his Corrosive Charge (Q) slow is a setup tool, not poke — if it lands, he will immediately try to E-flip you. Play slightly back of your usual poke range so Q slow alone cannot put you in his E cast radius. A poisoned Urgot who is also blinded and out of auto range simply takes free damage.
edits.after: Urgot cannot trade at level 1 without walking into your auto range, so the second he steps up to CS, land Blinding Dart (Q) and let E Toxic Shot coat his approach. He has no dash to close gap and his Purge (W) only fires while he walks toward you — the Purge bolts count as basic attacks, so the blind blanks every one of them alongside his autos and he loses the exchange entirely. Respect one thing: Corrosive Charge (Q) reaches 800 against your 680, so you cannot outrange it — sidestep the circle instead, because if it lands he will immediately try to E-flip you. A poisoned Urgot who is blinded and outside Purge's 490 simply takes free damage.

edits.before: Levels 4–5 are your strongest zone-control window but not a free kill lane. His base HP and passive resistances mean your poison ticks chip, not burst — do not greed for a solo kill by chasing him inside his tower. Instead, plant Noxious Trap (R) on the tribush and both river brushes so any jungler-assisted dive or Urgot step-in costs him a quarter of his HP bar before the fight starts. If Urgot ever E-flips you, your Move Quick (W) must be off cooldown for the escape — track that cooldown obsessively, because a flip into Purge range with W on cooldown is your death. At level 6 your traps begin covering both side entrances; zone the wave with shrooms and let your lead be positional, not a health-bar kill threat.
edits.after: Levels 4–5 are your strongest zone-control window but not a free kill lane, and you have no mushrooms yet — Noxious Trap arrives at 6. His base HP and passive resistances mean your poison ticks chip, not burst — do not greed for a solo kill by chasing him inside his tower. Hold your 680 against Purge's 490 and make him spend Corrosive Charge to reach you at all. If Urgot ever E-flips you, your Move Quick (W) must be off cooldown for the escape — track that cooldown obsessively, because a flip into Purge range with W on cooldown is your death. From level 6, plant Noxious Trap (R) on the tribush and both river brushes so any dive or step-in costs him a quarter of his HP bar before the fight starts.

edits.before: Urgot's only level-1 threat is walking up to auto and activating Purge — Blinding Shot cancels both, so you own the first trade completely.
edits.after: Urgot's only level-1 threat is walking up to auto and activating Purge — its bolts are basic attacks, so Blinding Dart cancels both outright.

edits.before: First item is approximately even: Liandry's Angueur ticks hurt on a high-HP Urgot, but his percent-HP Purge also scales — whoever is ahead in poke damage wins the coin flip trades.
edits.after: First item is approximately even: Liandry's Torment ticks hurt on a high-HP Urgot, but his percent-HP Purge also scales — whoever is ahead in poke damage wins the coin flip trades.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — His engage. Blind + kite it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, his engage, and it shields him. Blind + kite it. - Purge: 490 range into your 680, and 0 cooldown at max rank. - Fear Beyond Death: 100s.

edits.before: Track Urgot's Disdain (Flip): His engage. Blind + kite it. When it is down — Blind + poke him.
edits.after: Purge bolts count as basic attacks — Blinding Dart blanks the whole channel, not just his autos.

notes: The one claim I expected to be wrong here turned out to be right: I checked the Wiki because Echoing Flames' text lists "basic attacks and Purge" separately, which implies Purge is not a basic attack, but the Wiki states the bolts ARE basic attacks and therefore are blinded. Worth recording so nobody "fixes" it later. The no-mushrooms-before-6 error appears here for the third time in this slice (also Sylas and Tahm Kench) and mid additionally contradicts itself within one paragraph — that pattern is almost certainly file-wide.
